<note>: First record of a subagent sidecar transcript at <PROJECT-DIR>/<parent-session-uuid>/subagents/agent-<agentId>.jsonl. sessionId is the PARENT session's id, not a new session. isSidechain is true on every record in these files and false on every record in the top-level file — a strict partition. The Agent tool_use id in the parent does NOT equal agentId, so there is no direct dispatch->sidecar join key.
